description: 既知の脆弱性で修正版が未提供、または開発ツールのため本番に影響しないもの

backend.reason: Prisma 7 internal dependency (@prisma/client → prisma → @prisma/dev → @prisma/streams-local → ajv → fast-uri). Path traversal (GHSA-q3j6-qgpj-74h6) and host confusion (GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc). Fix requires prisma downgrade to 6.x (breaking change). No runtime impact - dev tool only.
Prisma 7 internal dependency (@prisma/dev). Authorization bypass via encoded slashes (GHSA-wc8c-qw6v-h7f6). Fix requires prisma downgrade to 6.x (breaking change). No runtime impact - dev tool only.
Prisma 7 internal dev tool. Contains hono/valibot as dependencies. No runtime impact.
Prisma 7 internal dependency (@prisma/dev). No runtime impact - dev tool only.
Depends on vulnerable @prisma/dev which contains @hono/node-server and @mrleebo/prisma-ast. Fix requires prisma downgrade to 6.x (breaking change). CLI tool only, not shipped to production runtime.
Prisma 7 internal dependency (@prisma/dev). No runtime impact - dev tool only.

Excel file processing library. No fix available. Prototype Pollution (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6) and ReDoS (GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9) vulnerabilities. Mitigated by server-side input validation and trusted file sources only.
Transitive minimatch ReDoS (GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26). @sentry/node@10.39.0 bundles minimatch@9.0.5. No fix available in current major version. Sentry upstream needs to update.
Depends on @sentry/node which has transitive minimatch ReDoS. No fix available in current major version.
Transitive glob/minimatch ReDoS (GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26). swagger-jsdoc@6.2.8 is the latest stable. v7 is RC only. No non-breaking fix available.
Transitive dependency of swagger-jsdoc. Uses minimatch <10.2.1 with ReDoS vulnerability. No non-breaking fix available.

ReDoS via repeated wildcards (GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26). Transitive dependency pulled in by swagger-jsdoc and @sentry/node. Fix requires minimatch >=10.2.1 which is a semver major change for consuming packages.

frontend.reason: Storybook build-time environment variable exposure. Dev tool only, not shipped to production.

Stored XSS via SVG Export (GHSA-hfvx-25r5-qc3w). Fix requires fabric >=7.2.0 (semver major from 6.9.1). Major version upgrade needs separate testing. Mitigated by sanitizing SVG output on the server side.
Optional transitive dependency with rimraf/glob/minimatch ReDoS chain (GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26). No non-breaking fix available.
Transitive dependency of @mapbox/node-pre-gyp. Uses glob <11 with minimatch ReDoS vulnerability. No non-breaking fix available.
Transitive dependency via @mapbox/node-pre-gyp/rimraf. Uses minimatch <10.2.1 with ReDoS vulnerability. No non-breaking fix available.
ReDoS via repeated wildcards (GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26). Transitive dependency pulled in by @mapbox/node-pre-gyp chain. Fix requires minimatch >=10.2.1 which is a semver major change.
